name: Bioinformatics Systems Developer
description: Process genomic data, implement sequence alignment, and build bioinformatics pipelines. Handle massive datasets with efficient algorithms.
example_snippet:
program KmerCounter:
    keep K as whole number with value 3
    keep Sequence as text
    put "ATCGATCGA" into Sequence

    keep SeqLen as whole number
    put call string_length with Sequence into SeqLen

    keep Count as whole number
    put the difference of SeqLen and K into Count
    put the sum of Count and 1 into Count

    print the text "Sequence: " and Sequence and newline
    print the text "K-mer count (K=" and K and "): " and Count and newline

    repeat Count times using I:
        print the text "K-mer at " and I and ": " and newline
    end repeat
end program
